statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is 9, low, for the 23:00Z hour. The weekend queue has now cleared: CME Globex reopened at 22:00Z and Nasdaq-100 futures printed 29,388.50, up 0.75 points and 0.00%, verified at 23:03Z, with S&P, Dow and VIX futures all within 0.1% of unchanged. Two genuine weekend catalysts, the new US 50% tariffs on $20bn of Canadian goods and Canada's matching retaliation, were absorbed without index-level repricing, so the unpriced-queue premium that lifted the previous hour to 15 is released. Stress is 42, moderate, easing from 45 but held up by WTI near $86 after a second consecutive weekly gain above 5%, long Treasury yields at 20-month highs with the 10-year near 4.74% and the 30-year near 5.27%, and Monday's 18:00Z US Treasury news conference on new Iran sanctions. Confidence is 86, high, because the live reopen print, the VIX, oil, H.15 yields, the weekend news and the week's calendar are all verified against primary sources. Tail remains below the block threshold across all twenty-four published hours, which carry conditional readings between 7 and 18.
recommendation: The observed reopen is consistent with functioning mean reversion rather than a one-way path. Nasdaq-100 futures were verified at 29,388.50, up 0.75 points and 0.00%, at 23:03Z on two independent quote sources, and the delayed cross-asset context agrees: S&P futures -0.02%, Dow futures -0.07%, VIX futures -0.01%, Treasury futures flat to marginally firmer and WTI -0.85%. That is the relevant evidence, because the weekend carried real headline risk. The United States imposed 50% tariffs on roughly $20bn of Canadian goods late on Friday and Canada announced dollar-for-dollar retaliation from 8 September, and the index repriced by less than a point. No persistent directional efficiency, shallow-pullback sequence or session-extreme behaviour is on record. The risk that remains is cross-asset and scheduled rather than structural: bond volatility drove last week's roughly 2% Nasdaq Composite decline with long yields back at 20-month highs, oil is elevated with the Strait of Hormuz severely disrupted, and the US Treasury holds a news conference on new Iran sanctions at 18:00Z on Monday, described in advance as targeting Iran's trading partners. Those factors raise Stress and reduce directional conviction without establishing the failure of mean reversion that Tail measures. The published danger window is kept narrow and covers the announcement hour and the power hour that follows it, where a delayed second leg running from oil into long yields and then into the index is the credible mechanism. Tail remains below the block threshold throughout.
headline: Sunday reopen cleared with no gap, Nasdaq-100 futures verified at 29,388.50 and 0.00%: Tail eases to 9, low, mapped policy state EA_ON, with conditional readings of 7 to 18 over the next twenty-three hours peaking at Monday's 18:00Z US Treasury news conference on new Iran sanctions.
body: CME Globex equity index futures reopened for the week at 22:00Z and, roughly an hour and a half later, the reopen has resolved without a gap. Nasdaq-100 futures were verified at 29,388.50, up 0.75 points and 0.00%, at 23:03Z, and a second independent source showed the September contract unchanged at 29,387.75 at 23:02Z. Delayed cross-asset context agrees across the board: S&P futures -0.02%, Dow futures -0.07%, VIX futures -0.01%, two-, five-, ten- and thirty-year Treasury futures flat to +0.11%, and WTI -0.85%. This matters because the weekend was not empty. The United States imposed 50% tariffs on roughly $20bn of Canadian goods late on Friday, covering wine, furniture, dairy, cement, clothing and hockey equipment, and Prime Minister Carney announced dollar-for-dollar Canadian retaliation on Saturday targeting US steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper and electronics from 8 September. Separately, the US Treasury has pre-announced a Monday news conference on new Iran sanctions. The index absorbed all of it with a move of well under one point, which is direct evidence against the pathological no-retracement path the Tail score measures, and it is why Tail steps down from the previous hour's 15 to 9. The twenty-four published slots run from 2026-08-23T23:00:00Z to 2026-08-24T22:00:00Z: the Asian overnight, the European session, the full Monday US cash session, the 21:00Z CME daily maintenance break and the Tuesday Globex reopen. Monday's 12:30Z Chicago Fed National Activity Index, the 13:30Z US cash open, the 15:30Z bill auctions, the 18:00Z US Treasury news conference, the power hour that follows and the 20:00Z cash close all fall inside the horizon. The last observed cash session was orderly: the Nasdaq-100 settled at 29,308.86 on Friday, up 0.33%, inside a 29,142.44 to 29,405.12 range whose extremes were both retraced, and the VIX finished at 14.89, down 6.0%. The week itself was negative, with the Nasdaq Composite down about 2% and the S&P 500 down about 1.4%, driven by bond volatility rather than earnings after the Treasury's larger buyback programme gave only temporary relief and long yields snapped back to 20-month highs. Friday's internals were split, with five of eight megacaps higher but the semiconductor complex averaging about -0.7%. Those conflicts raise Stress and reduce conviction; none of them is a Tail amplifier in the absence of observed directional structure. Confidence rises to 86 because a verified live futures print now exists for the current hour, alongside verified oil, VIX, H.15 yields and a verified weekend news record.

lookbackSummary: Claude coverage over the past twenty-four hours is nearly complete: twenty hourly assessments are available and four clock-hours have no published assessment and are marked unavailable, at 07:00Z, 10:00Z, 11:00Z and 12:00Z on 23 August. Tail held 4 through every hour of the weekend futures halt, when no Nasdaq-100 price path could develop at all, then stepped to 15 in the 22:00Z reopen hour to cover the still-unpriced weekend queue. The mapped policy state stayed EA_ON and the dominant mode remained normal throughout, so no hour approached the block threshold. Stress traced a full weekend arc, easing from 39 at the start of the window to a low of 34 through the European morning, then turning higher across the afternoon and evening to 45 in the final two pre-reopen hours as the weekend headline queue built around the Canadian tariff escalation and Monday's scheduled Iran announcement. Confidence drifted down from 87 to 82 over the same span as the last verified price observation receded further into the past.
outlookSummary: The current hour carries Tail 9 and Stress 42 on an observed, orderly and gapless reopen rather than on assumption, because a verified Nasdaq-100 futures print now exists for the slot. Conditional Tail then eases to a floor of 8 through the quiet Asian mid-session where two-way trade has historically been most reliable, and Stress decays with it to 36 as the weekend risk premium unwinds. Tail steps back to 10 for the European pre-open and to 12 at the 07:00Z European cash open, the session's first real liquidity event and the point at which any overnight drift is confirmed or faded, then eases again through a quiet European late morning. The 12:30Z Chicago Fed National Activity Index is treated as a checkpoint at Tail 11. The Monday US cash open inside the 13:00Z hour carries 15 for opening-auction continuation risk, easing to 14 and then 12 across the auction window and to 11 in the midday lull. The arc peaks at 18 for the 18:00Z US Treasury news conference on new Iran sanctions and holds 18 through the power hour that follows, where a delayed second leg running from oil into long yields and then into the index is the credible mechanism; both slots carry the event/whipsaw mode and both remain below the block threshold, since no post-announcement price path can be observed in advance. Tail falls to 14 into the 20:00Z cash close and to 7 across the 21:00Z CME maintenance break, when no continuous futures price path exists, before returning to 9 at the Tuesday Globex reopen. Confidence decays monotonically from 86 to 62 across the horizon as each slot sits further from the last verified print.
